title: Borrow, Then Move
goal: Reorder the three statements so the borrow ends before the move.
hints: archive takes the String by value - after that call, data is gone.
A borrow ends at its last use. Measure first, and the borrow is over before the move.
explanation: measure only borrows; archive consumes. Since a borrow ends at its last use (non-lexical lifetimes), reading before moving leaves no overlap: borrow, done, move, report. Any order that moves first hits E0382 - and no clone is ever needed. Statement order is a borrow-checker tool.
